Resolves #21825

`create-component` now runs in a workspace made by `npx neo-app`. It spawned `class.mjs`, `css.mjs`, `example.mjs` and `build/themes.mjs` by paths relative to the working directory. That folder is the engine only inside the engine's own checkout, so in a workspace the command failed with "Cannot find module '<workspace>/buildScripts/create/class.mjs'" before creating anything. The four targets now resolve from the engine's `buildScripts` folder (`path.join(__dirname, …)`), as the file-server spawn at `:223` already did. `cwd` stays the working directory, so the helpers still write into the workspace.

Evidence: L2 (a unit spec that runs the scripts in a temporary workspace, plus one run inside the engine) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-4). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 create-component exits 0 in a workspace and writes the class | `createComponent.spec.mjs` "create-component writes a view class and its style stub": `MyApp.view.Foo` extending `container.Base` exits 0 and writes `apps/myapp/view/Foo.mjs` and `resources/css/src/apps/myapp/Foo.css`. |
| AC-2 the spec fails on `dev` before the fix | Outside-CI: the same spec in a worktree of `dev` at `561b12f1bc`. That test fails with `Cannot find module '…/buildScripts/create/class.mjs'`, and the other passes. |
| AC-3 inside the engine's checkout, as before | Outside-CI: `node buildScripts/create/component.mjs -c Portal.view.ZzProbe -b container.Base -n no -C no -p no` exited 0 and wrote the class, its `src` style stub and one stub per theme. The probe files were removed afterwards. |
| AC-4 `create-class`, `create-app` and `create-app-minimal` run once | Same spec, second test: each runs with arguments in the temporary workspace, exits 0 and writes its file (`apps/myapp/view/Bar.mjs`, `apps/alpha/app.mjs`, `apps/beta/app.mjs`). |

## Deltas from ticket
- The temporary workspace carries `buildScripts/myApps.json`, as every generated workspace does (neomjs/create-app `tasks/createMyAppsJson.mjs`). Without it, `app.mjs` and `appMinimal.mjs` fall back to `buildScripts/webpack/json/myApps.template.json` under the working directory and fail with ENOENT. That template is the engine's own app list, so pointing the fallback at the engine would write Portal, Covid and the other engine apps into a workspace. A path change cannot fix it, so it is recorded as a defect-note rather than fixed here.
- `assertInteractivePrompt.spec.mjs`'s non-TTY component check planted stub `css.mjs` and `build/themes.mjs` in its workspace. That only worked while `component.mjs` spawned its helpers from the working directory. With the fix the stubs intercept nothing, and each case runs the real themes build, past the check's 5 s spawn timeout on hosted CI (`ETIMEDOUT`, run 44951019313). The stubs are removed and the spawn timeout is 60 s.

## Test Evidence
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createComponent.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/assertInteractivePrompt.spec.mjs` at `11cd8d1097`: 6 passed (12.4 s).
- The first hosted unit run also flaked on `fileServer.spec.mjs:276`, a race inside that file, recorded as a defect-note.
- The spec unlinks `node_modules/neo.mjs` before it removes its temporary workspace, so the cleanup cannot follow the link into the checkout.
